extraction.notes: Three months ended September 30, 2025 column from Attachment 2 (page 3). The basic FFO subtotal ($219,866) is followed by the Series E preferred distributions ($1,211) to reach diluted FFO ($221,077); I treated diluted FFO as ffo_total and put the preferred distributions in ffo_adjustments as 'other', since the diluted share count (356,873) includes Series E conversion. Software transition costs are placed under severance_restructuring (the category that covers software transition). Zero-amount lines (JV impairment, consolidation gain, property sale gain) are shown as '-' in the printed table. Per-share checks: 221,077/356,873=0.62; 232,322/356,873=0.65; 200,084/356,873=0.56. All subtotals foot. Amounts are in thousands.
